Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 11.2-11.3; courts F/G/K. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: post-M1 / extended capability.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2TVQTHW3KSESS9M0ET168; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7DCJMR1CR3QSXZCK51VY, bd-01M35A7BJ4GGFT1ZRJ3ZSEJ77Z.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own single-recall scale acceptance receipt, distinct from the broader novel/cohort parent. Reuse independent expected inventories, exact matrix and profiling instruments. No implementation-only benchmark claims.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Account for all 84 and all 524 IDs; select/reveal unit 524 and target 1000, inspect offscreen candidates, resize/200% zoom and return with unchanged scientific records.
2. Measure p95 selection feedback against 100ms and useful loaded view against 3s on declared fixture/hardware; publish distributions, memory/mark counts, warnings and failed budgets.
3. At resolution limit no numeric blending occurs; table/keyboard paths and repeated authoritative coordinates remain exact.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Qualify only measured configurations and retain truthful range/table fallback; do not close broad population gate from this receipt.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [Scale] Qualify whole-recall performance and resolution fallbacks
